evidence_snippets: The Dataproc Metastore API defines the following resource model: The service works with a collection of Google Cloud projects, named: /projects/ Each project has a collection of available locations, named: /locations/ (a location must refer to a Google Cloud region ) Each location has a collection of services, named: /services/ Dataproc Metastore services are resources with names of the form: /projects/{project number}/locations/{location id}/services/{service id} .
